title: Mr C Residences register form
description: A blush interest-list form: a small thin-line mark and a centred two-line invitation, then a centred two-column grid of underline-only fields (text inputs, chevron selects and a square-checkbox group) in red, closed by a full-width bold red pill that empties to an outline on hover. One column on phones. The form fades in as it enters the view.
notes: fields flow in rows of two on desktop, in the order given
fields are plain HTML (no state); point action/method at your handler
colours: primary for text, lines and the pill on the background colour
